ore.name: Ore
ore.desc: Dug from the Bloom. The Forge smelts it into ingots.

hide.name: Hide
hide.desc: From wild creatures. The War Room weaves it into cloth.

dust.name: Crystal dust
dust.desc: From crystal creatures and chests. The Vault fires it into glass.

herbs.name: Herbs
herbs.desc: Grown in the Garden. The Spring brews them into tonics.

silk.name: Spore silk
silk.desc: Grown in the Garden. Woven with hide into cloth.

ingot.name: Ingot
ingot.desc: Smelted at the Forge from 2 ore.

cloth.name: Cloth
cloth.desc: Woven in the War Room from hide and silk.

glass.name: Glass
glass.desc: Fired in the Vault from 2 crystal dust.

tonic.name: Tonic
tonic.desc: Brewed at the Spring. Carry up to 3 into a raid: one is drunk automatically at 25% HP and heals 40%.

parts.name: Weapon parts
parts.desc: Barrels, grips and edges for forging weapons.

sap.name: Bog sap
sap.desc: From the Sump's pools and Venom creatures. The Apothecary brews it with herbs.

serum.name: Gene serum
serum.desc: Raises the weaker copy of a creature's lowest gene by 1, up to 10. Use it from the creature's card.

apexshard.name: Apex shard
apexshard.desc: Only from the Unbound Bloom. Fuels the Apex Chamber.

bloomscar.name: Bloomscar serum
bloomscar.desc: Writes the Bloomscar shine into one copy of a creature's shine gene. Only from Unbound tier 8 and deeper.

lens.name: Lens
lens.desc: Ground glass for gilded cages and satchel clasps.

cages.name: Cages
cages.desc: Two cages, more at higher quality.

gilded.name: Gilded cage
gilded.desc: A cage that catches far more often.

satchel.name: Satchel
satchel.desc: Worn into raids for extra bag slots. Lost if you fall.

striker.name: Striker
striker.desc: Hits hardest: +20% damage, and its combos hit 30% harder.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.desc: +25% HP, and you take 15% less damage while it fights near you.

medic.name: Medic
medic.desc: Heals you and the party 0.8% a second, and 4% a second for 3s after its ability.

scout.name: Scout
scout.desc: Reveals the map, secret rooms and rare creatures.

catcher.name: Catcher
catcher.desc: Cage radius +30% and +10% catch chance on weakened wilds.

forage.name: Rootworks forage
forage.desc: A short trip for food, herbs and hide.

seams.name: Ore seams
seams.desc: Dig the old seams for ore and crystal dust.

hollows.name: Crystal hollows
hollows.desc: Needs a Crystal or Echo creature to find the way. Dust, glass and sometimes an egg.

galleries.name: Drowned galleries
galleries.desc: Needs a Tide creature to swim the flooded lanes. Hide, herbs, memory shards and eggs.
